switchback-garden.name: Switchback Garden
switchback-garden.brief: A bigger garden. Find the blue switch to open the key room.
switchback-garden.hint: Stand on the blue switch. Its matching gates stay open.

lantern-courtyard.name: Lantern Courtyard
lantern-courtyard.brief: The beetle aims before it charges. Dodge sideways and slip through.
lantern-courtyard.hint: Amber light means the beetle is aiming. Its charge cannot turn.

twin-watch.name: Twin Watch
twin-watch.brief: Two patrols, two tempting rooms. Pick your moment to pass.
twin-watch.hint: Each guard has its own patrol. One pebble can distract nearby guards.

crumbling-hall.name: Crumbling Hall
crumbling-hall.brief: A broken hall with a quiet outside route and a noisy central shortcut.
crumbling-hall.hint: Loose stones make noise. Watch the central patrol, or take the wider outside path.

leafy-crossroads.name: Leafy Crossroads
leafy-crossroads.brief: Wait in the leaves, pocket the key, and cross to the far hatch.
leafy-crossroads.hint: Leaves hide you while still. Wait for a gap in the patrol.

echo-cistern.name: Echo Cistern
echo-cistern.brief: Follow two switches into the cistern. Listen for danger beyond the next room.
echo-cistern.hint: Blue opens the middle chamber. Amber opens the key chamber.

buried-observatory.name: Buried Observatory
buried-observatory.brief: A short plate crossing leads to the central switch. Either bank can raise it again.
buried-observatory.hint: The turquoise plate raises the crossing for eight seconds. There is another plate on the far bank.

moonlit-escape.name: Moonlit Escape
moonlit-escape.brief: Two patrols and a moonlit return. One seed can grow a hiding place.
moonlit-escape.hint: Press F on bare ground to grow leaves. Stop inside them to hide. Keep your pebble for a tight crossing.

quiet-vault.name: The Quiet Vault
quiet-vault.brief: A guarded key. Two shortcuts. Your first escape.
quiet-vault.hint: Cracked walls are shortcuts. Stand still in leaves to hide.

reed-bank.name: Reed Bank
reed-bank.brief: A forked river, three tongue grabs, and two different bank routes.
reed-bank.hint: Face the key from the bank and press R. The southern shallows are swimmable, but slow your feet.

split-shelves.name: Split Shelves
split-shelves.brief: Staggered shelves climb past a central switch. One tongue grab can spare a guarded detour.
split-shelves.hint: Open blue from the central shelf. Save your single tongue grab for a risky shelf; burrows are shortcuts.

stillwater-vault.name: Stillwater Vault
stillwater-vault.brief: Only two tongue grabs. Quiet feet and leaf cover are your other tools.
stillwater-vault.hint: Reach from the north bank, or take the longer walking route from below.

forked-fort.name: Forked Fort
forked-fort.brief: Uneven terraces branch around a central hub. Two switches open the far fork.
forked-fort.hint: Blue opens the upper fork. Amber opens the lower return. Burrowing is an optional shortcut.

backlash-hall.name: Backlash Hall
backlash-hall.brief: The ruins start pushing back. Bringing a key home may need a different route.
backlash-hall.hint: Open blue to reach the key. Listen when the old mechanisms stir.

reactions.message: Stone grinds behind you. Blue is sealing; the south passage has opened.
reactions.objective: The entrance is sealed. Return through the south passage.

false-refuge.name: False Refuge
false-refuge.brief: A quiet chamber, a closing entrance. Look for another way through.
false-refuge.hint: Blue opens the middle chamber. Leave room to dodge its beetle.

reactions.message: The entrance is sealing. Amber leads onward; a south passage has opened.
reactions.objective: Blue is sealed. Find the amber switch in this chamber.

reactions.message: The key releases the north passage. Blue stays sealed.
reactions.objective: The north passage is open. Reach the hatch in the west.

greedy-gallery.name: Greedy Gallery
greedy-gallery.brief: A tempting chest and a maze with its own plans. Is the detour worth it?
greedy-gallery.hint: Blue leads into the gallery. A chest can change more than your treasure count.

reactions.message: The chest clicks. Blue is sealing; an amber way east has opened.
reactions.objective: The gallery entrance is sealed. Take the amber passage east.

reactions.message: The key seals blue and releases the south passage. Find the new way home.
reactions.objective: Return through the south passage. Blue will not reopen.

turning-citadel.name: Turning Citadel
turning-citadel.brief: Two reversals. Four patrols. The way in will not be the way out.
turning-citadel.hint: Open blue and take the key. Look for lit passages when the citadel changes.

reactions.message: Blue is sealing. The inner passage has opened below the key room.
reactions.objective: Follow the inner passage into the central chamber.

reactions.message: The inner passage is sealing. West is open; amber unlocks the final crossing.
reactions.objective: Leave west. Amber opens the southern crossing.

razor-crossing.name: Razor Crossing
razor-crossing.brief: One pebble. Two snakes share the key room. Make the opening count.
razor-crossing.hint: The stone divider breaks sight. Save your pebble for the two key-room patrols.

reactions.message: Blue is sealing. Take the inner passage and find amber.
reactions.objective: Find amber in the centre, then cross the southern bridge.

needle-vault.name: Needle Vault
needle-vault.brief: One tongue grab, no decoys. A guarded vault below the stream.
needle-vault.hint: Reach the north bank. Spend your only grab on the key, or brave the vault.

reactions.message: The vault doors are sealing. A passage has opened beneath the chamber.
reactions.objective: The vault descent is open. Reach the eastern hatch.

toll-of-ash.name: Toll of Ash
toll-of-ash.brief: The hatch demands four treasure. Five enemies make every detour a decision.
toll-of-ash.hint: The hatch needs the key and four treasure. A chest is worth three.

threefold-keep.name: Threefold Keep
threefold-keep.brief: Three reversals. Five enemies. The last door answers to a chest.
threefold-keep.hint: The key opens the descent. Watch for new paths after each reversal.

reactions.message: Blue is sealing. The inner passage has opened.
reactions.objective: Follow the inner passage into the central vault.

reactions.message: The inner passage is sealing. West is open, but the chest holds the final mechanism.
reactions.objective: Find the chest in this vault. It releases the final crossing.

reactions.message: The chest seals west. The vault descent and final crossing are open.
reactions.objective: Descend from the vault, then cross east to the hatch.

last-light.name: Last Light
last-light.brief: Fifty seconds. Five patrols. The key changes the return route.
last-light.hint: Find a switch route to the key. Save your grab and keep the clock in mind.

reactions.message: Blue is sealing. Amber and south are open; the clock is still running.
reactions.objective: Return south and reach the eastern hatch before the light fades.

crown-of-thorns.name: Crown of Thorns
crown-of-thorns.brief: Six enemies, three reversals, and a hatch that demands six treasure.
crown-of-thorns.hint: Amber releases the descent. The central chest is worth the risk.

reactions.message: Blue is sealing. Amber releases the descent and eastern stair.
reactions.objective: Take the descent or amber route. The hatch needs six treasure.

reactions.message: The key releases the east bridge. Treasure is still the price of escape.
reactions.objective: The east bridge is open. Bring six treasure to the eastern hatch.

reactions.message: The chest seals the descent and opens the western passages.
reactions.objective: Use the western passages and east bridge. The hatch needs six treasure.

mire-mouth.name: Mire Mouth
mire-mouth.brief: Slow bog banks, crouching toads, and something stirring after the key.
mire-mouth.hint: Mud slows feet. A toad crouches before a short leap. Dodge its lane.

reactions.message: The upper bank seals. Reeds shake behind you; the southern bank opens.
reactions.objective: Go down the eastern bank to the southern hatch. Leave the shaking reeds.

silk-galleries.name: Silk Galleries
silk-galleries.brief: Offset shelves, silk traps and a gallery that seals behind you.
silk-galleries.hint: Spiders mark the ground before laying silk. Keep moving; webs fade.

reactions.message: The top gallery seals. A shelf cracks open behind you; the eastern stair opens.
reactions.objective: Take the eastern stair to the key. Keep clear of the cracked shelf.

reactions.message: The hatch stair opens. Something climbs out of the southern shelves.
reactions.objective: Follow the eastern stair down. Watch the emerging den.

falling-span.name: Falling Span
falling-span.brief: High bridges over dark water. The first crossing will not stay open.
falling-span.hint: The middle chest releases the lower crossing. Listen for a den opening.

reactions.message: The bridge seals behind you. A toad emerges on the old crossing; the eastern descent opens.
reactions.objective: Take the eastern descent. Find the central chest for a lower crossing.

reactions.message: The chest seals the middle bridge and releases the lower crossing. A den opens below.
reactions.objective: Use the lower crossing to reach the western hatch.

echo-fan.name: Echo Fan
echo-fan.brief: A branching cavern. Every prize wakes another side of the nest.
echo-fan.hint: The central chest opens the north arm. The key releases a western return.

reactions.message: The southern arm seals. The north arm opens—and the nest stirs behind you.
reactions.objective: Explore the north and east arms. The hatch needs six treasure.

reactions.message: The east arm seals. A western passage opens as a toad wakes in its den.
reactions.objective: Go north around the east arm, then follow the west passage to the hatch.

hungry-observatory.name: Hungry Observatory
hungry-observatory.brief: Four round chambers, nine hunters, and three awakenings. The vault is listening.
hungry-observatory.hint: The north chest releases the western shutters. Taking the key seals the east approaches.

reactions.message: The vault releases the western shutters. Two sleeping dens stir.
reactions.objective: Take the eastern key, then bring seven treasure to the western hatch.

reactions.message: The east approaches seal. The high return opens—and a snake emerges below.
reactions.objective: Return by the high northern crossing, then take the western shutters.

fern-cloister.name: Fern Cloister
fern-cloister.brief: An abandoned courtyard. The leaves sound closer than they should.
fern-cloister.hint: The fern paths meet at the old courtyard. The eastern stair leads home.

reactions.message: Stone grinds below the courtyard. The eastern stair opens.
reactions.objective: Carry the key down the eastern stair.

drowned-steps.name: Drowned Steps
drowned-steps.brief: Flooded terraces linked by narrow, uneven crossings.
drowned-steps.hint: The western chest lowers the high crossing. The key opens the descent.

reactions.message: The chest lowers a crossing over the northern water.
reactions.objective: Cross north to find the terrace key.

reactions.message: The old crossing folds away. The eastern descent settles into place.
reactions.objective: Take the eastern descent to the lower hatch.

root-cathedral.name: Root Cathedral
root-cathedral.brief: Roots split a vaulted nave into crooked side aisles. Two vaults demand a return.
root-cathedral.hint: The east chest releases the northern vault. Roots shift after the key is taken.

reactions.message: A root tears free. Two distant vaults echo.
reactions.objective: Find the key in the northern vault.

reactions.message: The eastern aisle seals. Soil shifts in the nave; the western vault opens.
reactions.objective: Bring five treasure and the key to the western vault.

ember-quarry.name: Ember Quarry
ember-quarry.brief: A cut-stone spiral, blind ledges, and a descent that changes underfoot.
ember-quarry.hint: The upper cache releases the inner ledge. Follow its descent toward the hatch.

reactions.message: The cache releases a ledge deep inside the quarry.
reactions.objective: Circle the quarry to reach the inner key.

reactions.message: The ledge above folds shut. A stair opens beneath the inner chamber.
reactions.objective: Take the inner descent to the hatch.

canopy-crown.name: Canopy Crown
canopy-crown.brief: Island shrines above the canopy. Three offerings wake the roots beneath them.
canopy-crown.hint: Each shrine opens another crossing. Bring six treasure to the crown hatch.

reactions.message: The south root twists shut. The high shrine crossing unfurls.
reactions.objective: Take the high crossing to the key.

reactions.message: The old eastern root snaps shut. A lower root stretches toward the last shrine.
reactions.objective: Follow the eastern root to the lower shrine.

reactions.message: The last offering releases the crown bridge. Branches shiver behind you.
reactions.objective: Bring six treasure and the key across the crown bridge.

glowcap-grotto.name: Glowcap Grotto
glowcap-grotto.brief: Blue fungi trace a flooded cavern. The wooden crossing will not last.
glowcap-grotto.hint: Stand on the turquoise plate. The crossing stays up briefly after you leave.

tideglass-causeway.name: Tideglass Causeway
tideglass-causeway.brief: Three luminous islands. Cross before the planks fold beneath the tide.
tideglass-causeway.hint: Both banks have a plate. Wake a bridge again if its light fades.

reactions.message: The tide draws back from the eastern descent. Something flutters below.
reactions.objective: Follow the eastern descent to the lower hatch.

pulse-garden.name: Pulse Garden
pulse-garden.brief: Glowing root loops surround a vault with a fading entrance.
pulse-garden.hint: The vault plate opens its stone block briefly. Another plate waits inside.

reactions.message: The eastern root shutters close. The garden releases a western loop.
reactions.objective: Return through the central root loop to reach the hatch.

spore-engine.name: Spore Engine
spore-engine.brief: Offset pump chambers breathe in the dark. Two plates lift two heavy blocks.
spore-engine.hint: Let each plate light up before leaving. Each block has a plate on both sides.

reactions.message: The lower pump releases its shutter. Pale wings stir in a pipe behind you.
reactions.objective: Take the lower pump path toward the hatch.

nightbloom-reach.name: Nightbloom Reach
nightbloom-reach.brief: A broken crescent above black water. The last chest wakes the far bank.
nightbloom-reach.hint: The high plate releases a short-lived crossing. The lower shrine opens the final bridge.

reactions.message: The middle neck twists shut. A lower shutter opens over the black water.
reactions.objective: Follow the eastern bank to the lower shrine.

reactions.message: The chest unfurls the final crossing. A lantern wakes behind you.
reactions.objective: Bring six treasure and the key across the lower crossing.
